title: ItemBingo
description: A Small Item Bingo. OP Permissions required!
body:
This is an **Minecraft** **Item** **Bingo**. Do /startbingo as an **OP** to start the **Bingo!** When started there is an chatmessage poping up where it says "The Bingo has Started!". Every Text in this Plugin is in German because i am German. If the Bingo started then you get an compass, when you rightclick it an Bingo Cart Menu appears where all the items you need to get are. The Rules are the same as the normal Bingo. 

**Bingo Rules**: 
- Get a diagonal row off items and you Win!
- Get an normal row of items and you Win!
